units.source_text: 他一站起来，各骨关节便咔啦咔啦发出风吹铁皮屋顶似的声音。

en.t: As soon as he stood up, all his joints rattled like wind blowing over a tin roof.

units.source_text: 他提心吊胆地张望了一下水缸，水补充得满满地，直到水缸口。

en.t: With his heart in his throat, he glanced toward the water jar; it had been filled right up to the rim.

units.source_text: 他把手巾打湿，按在脸上。

en.t: He wet the towel and pressed it against his face.

units.source_text: 战栗，发出荧光，穿透全身。

en.t: A shudder, glowing with a fluorescent light, pierced through his whole body.

units.source_text: 他冲洗了头和腋下，擦掉了手缝里的沙子。

en.t: He rinsed his head and armpits, and wiped away the sand from between his fingers.

units.source_text: 人生的目的也许应该就在这瞬间固定住吧。

en.t: Perhaps the purpose of life ought to be fixed in place at just such a moment.
